short: The massive Allied amphibious and airborne invasion of Sicily, which triggered the collapse of Benito Mussolini's regime.
full:
On 9 July 1943, combined Allied forces launched a massive assault on the Italian island of Sicily, utilizing thousands of ships and aircraft. Despite high winds that scattered airborne drops and complicated the amphibious landings, the sheer scale of the assault overwhelmed the Italian coastal defences. The American and British armies then raced across the island, engaging in fierce fighting against capable German reinforcements.

The swift loss of the island fatally undermined support for the Italian fascist government, leading to Mussolini being deposed and arrested later that month. Although tens of thousands of Axis troops managed to successfully evacuate across the Strait of Messina to the Italian mainland, the operation secured the Mediterranean shipping lanes and established a vital staging area for the invasion of Italy.
